'''Inkari''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who joined the radicalized [[Order of Revan]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Holding the title of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]], Inkari was among the Revanite commanders who led the Revanite forces in defense of the [[Temple of Sacrifice]] during the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|battle]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Inkari was [[Death/Legends|slain]] in the ruins near the Temple's gates by forces from the Imperial-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] coalition.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Commander Inkari appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', a [[2014]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is one of four named enemies that must be defeated by players in the mission "The Enemy Within." Her helmet includes a graphics error that hides or prevents her face from rendering, but if one is close enough to Inkari, her face is visible and depicts her as a fair-skinned Human with solid red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], the kind used for the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] species.<ref name="TOR" />
